concept.title: Red Hat Quay proof of concept host requirements
concept.shortdesc: Before you deploy a proof of concept Red Hat Quay registry, ensure your host meets minimum hardware requirements and you have Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 with an active subscription. You also need Podman for running containers in this guide.

ul.li:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9
Obtain the latest version of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 from the Red Hat Customer Portal.
See the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 product documentation for installation instructions.
An active subscription to Red Hat

Approximately 30 GB of disk space on your test system, which can be broken down as follows:
Approximately 10 GB of disk space for the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating system.
Approximately 10 GB of disk space for Docker storage for running three containers.
Approximately 10 GB of disk space for Red Hat Quay local storage.
CEPH or other local storage might require more memory.
See the Quay 3.x sizing guidelines for more information on sizing.

The following architectures are supported for Red Hat Quay:
amd64/x86_64
s390x
ppc64le
